comparison.objective: Transfer a hose-mounted gladhand from a dummy and lock it to the correct trailer coupling.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain face-seal compression while rotating a hose-loaded quarter-turn coupling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct red coupling, ≤2 mm plate separation, within 10° of stop, 60 N retention, released safely. No iterative response criterion.
comparison.reason: Although both include rotation and locking, this tests mating and retaining two couplers under hose load, not unlocking a setscrew, tuning a collar, and validating repeated impacts.
